description: 6. Offer is more important than copy. The right offer, framed correctly, will do more for you than world class copy. This was another nugget from a large emailer in the reddit coldemail sub. In case you haven't figured it out yet, you need to read a bunch of stuff from that sub. It's the best for cold email. A named free deliverable per industry will outperform a generic "let's chat". Example: Reply "yes" to get a free marketing checkup. Answer "1" for a free business audit. You get the idea.
